description: Owner only: disconnect this workspace's GitHub connection. It revokes every repository grant under it, so auto-deploy and linked sources stop at once. The GitHub App stays installed for other workspaces; github_connect starts a new connection. Destructive: requires confirmed: true. Read github_status afterwards.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: github_disconnect
